title: EU bank watchdog seeks European Commission rules for crypto firms offering DeFi lending
summary: The EBA renewed its call for the commission to propose rules for crypto firms granting client access to DeFi, particularly lending protocols.

title: Ukrainian lawmakers pass crypto tax and regulation bill expected to bring in $330 million
summary: Lawmaker Yaroslav Zhelezniak said he expects roughly $330 million (15 billion hryvnias) in added budget revenue, though the time frame remains unclear.

title: Crypto Long & Short: Bitcoin investors can’t keep ignoring Japan
summary: Yen-funded carry trades ran an estimated $250 billion before the August 2024 selloff, and the Bank of Japan's policy rate is now around 1.25%. Phillip Lord of Bitcoin Japan explains how yen funding conditions reach bitcoin, and the shareholder test Japanese companies' bitcoin treasury strategies should have to pass.

title: South Korean crypto exchange Bithumb warns of phishing after deeper October breach probe
summary: South Korea's second-largest crypto exchange said its trading systems were not breached, but stolen customer records could already be being used in future scams.

title: Fed’s preferred inflation gauge lands with a December rate increase already priced in
